## Mission

End hunger in the Miami Valley by getting good food to every neighbor who
needs it.

## Theory of change

Reliable access to fresh food lowers household stress and frees up income for
rent and medicine.

## Programs

### Pantry Network

- **Type**: Direct services
- **Description**: Two walk-in pantry sites open five days a week.
- **Population served**: Households in Montgomery County
